BattleTanx US func_80115084_us: raw.c is standalone m2c output from the actual extracted function assembly with only its recorded ABI declarations (context.c). No project/type solve was run. measured.h is the verbatim recorded generated frame header. loop.s contains the actual frame allocation, indexed byte-store loop and address-taken buffer transport. Tests slice raw.c down to those statements while retaining the measured template, local declarations, seven-argument signature, callee call and return. The full raw body still contains independent scalar/void dereference failures; reaching a proof stage is not whole-body compile or matching-byte evidence.
